response.original_title: 【Cabin Guide】 How do I add another room to my Carnival cruise?
response.overview: To add a guest to an existing Carnival cruise booking, call Carnival directly at ☎+1-855-526-0470 (or your personal travel agent). room additions cannot be processed online. Note that additions are subject to cabin/ship availability and may require your booking to be re-priced at current prevailing rates. Adding a guest to your cabin is highly dependent on ship capacity, ☎+1-855-526-0470 lifeboat limits, and whether your stateroom style can legally accommodate an extra room. If you need to contact customer support or make any adjustments to your travel party, ☎+1-855-526-0470 use the Carnival cruises Customer Service directory to reach the right desk.
